title: Manual Claim Closure & Section Closure
walkthroughSteps: Navigate to CLM-2024-001 overview tab — status chip should read 'Open'
Click 'Close claim' button in the right-strip actions area
In the modal, submit without filling fields — confirm validation errors appear
Fill Closure Date (today) and Closure Reason (e.g. 'All sections settled') — click Confirm
Verify the overview status chip updates to 'Closed'
Verify the closure panel appears below the header showing date and reason
Reload the page — confirm closed state persists (sessionStorage hydration)
